title: Something in Cargo Bay 3
text: The crew finds a heat signature behind the water tanks. It's a teenage girl, half-frozen, clutching a stolen ration bar.

choices.text: Give her a bunk. One more mouth to feed.
choices.result: Mira eats like she hasn't in weeks. Then she fixes the galley dispenser that nobody else could.

choices.text: Sedate her and put her in an empty cryo pod.
choices.result: She'll wake up on Earth 2 with no memory of the trip. Maybe that's a kindness.

choices.text: Hand her over at the next station for the bounty.
choices.result: Fifty credits. The crew avoids your eyes for days.

title: Micrometeoroid Swarm
text: Proximity alarms scream. A cloud of sand-sized debris is moving faster than any bullet, and it's directly ahead.

choices.result: The deflectors glow white. The swarm passes like rain on a window.

outcomes.result: It sounds like hail on a tin roof. Minor damage.
A fragment punches clean through the mess deck.

choices.result: Your pilot threads the needle without breaking a sweat.

title: Hydroponics Bloom
text: The hydroponics bay is overflowing. Something in the new nutrient mix worked better than expected.

choices.result: Fresh greens for the first time in weeks.

choices.text: Have the Scientist tune the growth cycle first.
choices.result: A careful harvest, and a second crop already sprouting.

title: Cryo Bay Alarm
text: A coolant loop has failed in the cryo bay. Twelve pods are warming up.

choices.result: Twenty tense minutes later, the readings settle back to blue.

choices.text: Reroute ship power to keep them cold.
choices.result: The lights dim across the ship, but every pod holds.
You watch twelve heartbeats slow to nothing on the monitor.

title: Distress Call
text: A weak signal on an emergency band: "...anyone... life support failing... please..."

outcomes.result: A starving mining family. You share your food, and they pay you with everything they have.
It's a pirate lure. You blast free, with less hull and fewer credits.
There's one survivor, an engineer who insists on working off the debt.

choices.text: Keep flying. You can't save everyone.
choices.result: The signal fades behind you. Nobody speaks at dinner.

title: Free Trader
text: A battered free trader matches your course. "Fuel, food, I deal in anything. What do you need?"

choices.result: The fuel smells off, but it burns.
They pay in good chits.
The trader peels away, unbothered.

title: Tempers Flare
text: Shouting from the galley. Two of your crew are at each other's throats over the last coffee pouch.

choices.result: Order is restored. Grudges are not.
Black eyes, then a grudging handshake. Oddly, the mood improves.

choices.text: Double rations tonight to cool tempers.
choices.result: Full bellies make for quieter halls.

title: Solar Flare
text: A massive flare is erupting behind you. Radiation will hit in minutes.

choices.result: The shields hold. Barely.

choices.text: Everyone into the shielded core until it passes.
choices.result: A cramped, sweaty day. Everyone lives.

choices.text: Hand out anti-rad meds and press on.
choices.result: Nausea, headaches, but no lasting harm.

title: Void Fever
text: A crew member wakes burning hot, muttering that the stars are watching them.

choices.text: Treat them in the med bay.
choices.result: The fever breaks after a long night.

outcomes.result: The fever breaks, but it leaves them weak.

title: A Repeating Signal
text: A pattern of prime numbers is pulsing from somewhere ahead. It's not natural.

outcomes.result: Navigation data from a lost survey ship. The colony charter will pay well for it.
It's a recording of a dying ship's last minutes, looping forever.

choices.result: Someone else's mystery.

title: Scrubber Failure
text: The main CO2 scrubber grinds to a halt. Backup systems kick in, but they're thirsty.

choices.result: Good as new. Better, maybe.
The backups burn through your reserves.

title: A Birthday Aboard
text: It's someone's birthday. The crew asks if they can make a fuss.

choices.result: Paper hats made from old manuals. Off-key singing. It's perfect.
The cake mix goes back in storage.

title: No Questions Asked
text: A freighter captain offers 300 credits to carry three sealed crates to the Lantern Waystation. No questions asked.

choices.result: The crates hum faintly. You decide not to think about it.
The captain shrugs and moves on.

title: Hull Fatigue
text: Hairline cracks are spreading along a structural rib. The ship is getting old.

choices.result: Stronger than it was.
It'll hold. Probably.

title: An Early Waker
text: Pod 117 opens on its own. A colonist stumbles out, confused and asking if they've arrived.

choices.result: Dov is clumsy, but tireless.

choices.text: Sedate them and refreeze the pod.
choices.result: Back to sleep. They won't remember.

title: The Veil
text: Earth 2's star system greets you with a curtain of shimmering light that stretches for millions of kilometres.

choices.result: Nobody says a word for an hour. Some of them are crying.
It's beautiful in the rear camera too.
